units.speaker: Anna
units.text: There's an anchor on the sign.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: And a lot of brick.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: This is Twin Anchors, at 1655 North Sedgwick Street.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: It's been a tavern since 1932, in a three-story brick building from 1881 that was once a brewery.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: 1932. That's Prohibition.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Yes. It began as a place called Tante Lee Soft Drinks, where "soft drinks" was a code for alcohol.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: One account says a secret door in the south wall let people escape if the police raided the place.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: A secret door. I'm putting that in the bet column.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: It's the restaurant's own story, so enjoy it as that.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: And Sinatra?

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Frank Sinatra was a regular in the 1950s and 1960s.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: He had a favorite booth, and a phone jack was installed so he could take calls there.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: A phone jack. In the booth. Of course.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: And in 1981, when he headlined ChicagoFest, he ordered a fifty-rib dinner for himself and his staff.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Fifty ribs.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: The restaurant is known for its ribs.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: They're cooked twice a day, every day, and it serves an estimated twelve hundred racks a week.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Twelve hundred. Okay, I'm hungry again.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: You can ask about the Sinatra booth when you go in.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: The tavern also appeared in two films, Return to Me in 1999 and The Dark Knight in 2008.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: And who owns it now?

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Phillip and Laureen Tuzi bought it in 1978.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Their children run it today, so it's the third family to own it.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: A third family. In a place that old.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: That's pretty good.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: That's a good ending for the afternoon.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Order a drink, and pause here.
